BRING YOUR OWN HARDWARE

Give your device a pulse.

The downloadable Python project includes a FastAPI backend, read-only Linux agent, pytest suite and Docker configuration. The hosted page runs a browser simulation; it cannot receive your private device telemetry.

  1. Start the local backend: python -m edgepulse.server
  2. Set the same random EDGEPULSE_TOKEN (24+ characters) on server and agent.
  3. On your Linux device run:
edgepulse-agent --url http://YOUR-LAB-HOST:8000 \
  --id my-edge --name "My edge device"

Raspberry Pi / Jetson compatibility is a target, not a completed board test. CPU and memory come from Linux /proc; temperature is optional. GPU, inference and FPGA measurements are not implemented. Use TLS and an authenticated network boundary beyond a trusted local lab.
